up: Retrieve all molecules that are associated with the document identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4052615. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results ascending by the molecule's ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4052615'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
